verdict.rationale: Beamer is a SaaS changelog and engagement tool, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no such opt-out control. It only describes engagement analytics such as views, unique users and clicks, which concern tracking end users, not opting out of tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
